$comment: Max gzip KiB per example production bundle (ADR 0018, gyral-g1r.2). Baseline: 0.2.0 + 0.1 KiB. "view": the view layer's client API built with the gyral-compiled condition (scripts/size/view-entry.js), measured in Phase 2 + 0.1 KiB. Only ever lower these: pnpm size --check fails above a budget and suggests tightening when a bundle is 0.5 KiB under. Phase 3 (view-layer swap, gyral-g1r.7): budgets over by up to 0.4 KiB were raised to measured + 0.1 KiB TEMPORARILY, pending the size pass gyral-g1r.18 (bmi, counter, custom-driver, hello-lastname, http-random-user, routing-view, typeahead-race); budgets more than 0.5 KiB under were lowered. Phase 5 (hydration, gyral-g1r.10): hydration is built into core (view/07), about +1.6–1.9 KiB gzip in every bundle; every budget it pushed over was raised to measured + 0.1 KiB TEMPORARILY, pending gyral-g1r.18 (a lazily loaded hydration chunk is the main candidate).
